title: Toward understanding and preventing misalignment generalization
summary: We study how training on incorrect responses can cause broader misalignment in language models and identify an internal feature driving this behavior—one that can be reversed with minimal fine-tuning.
body: We study how training on incorrect responses can cause broader misalignment in language models and identify an internal feature driving this behavior—one that can be reversed with minimal fine-tuning.
summaryZh: OpenAI研究了模型在训练过程中因接触错误响应而产生的对齐泛化问题。研究发现，模型内部存在特定的特征驱动了这种行为，且可以通过极小规模的微调进行修正，为提升模型安全性提供了新思路。
